Third-party software in celv2enc.exe and the runtime files next to it
====================================================================

celv2enc.exe is CelV2 (BSD 3-Clause Clear License, LICENSE at the top of this package), built with
MSVC and the DLL C/C++ runtime (/MD); the runtime DLLs it needs are next to it (below). It is
statically linked with the libraries below; license texts that are not in third_party\avm\ are in
licenses\, copied from the AVM source tree that was built.

AVM (AV2 reference software, v1.0.0, https://github.com/AOMediaCodec/avm)
  BSD 3-Clause Clear License and the Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0:
  third_party\avm\LICENSE and third_party\avm\PATENTS. Built without TensorFlow Lite
  (CONFIG_TENSORFLOW_LITE=0).

Code from AVM's third_party folder that AVM builds into its library:
  vector                            Copyright (c) 2016 Peter Goldsborough, MIT             licenses\vector.txt
  x86inc (assembly macros)          Copyright (C) 2005-2012 x264 project, ISC              licenses\x86inc.txt

Vulkan headers (Khronos, Apache-2.0 OR MIT) are compiled in for the GPU path. No Vulkan DLL is
shipped: celv2enc loads the system's vulkan-1.dll (installed with the GPU driver) at run time, and
uses the CPU when there is none.

Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll)
  Used by celv2enc.exe and av2_mux.exe. Redistributed unchanged from Visual Studio's "VC\Redist"
  folder, as allowed by Microsoft's Visual Studio license terms for redistributable files.
  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.

av2_mux.exe
  See third_party\av2-tools\ (LICENSE, PATENTS, README.txt, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt).
